scope: Authenticated file opening and protected recovery executable only. Database snapshot, delta, receiver creation, freeze, cutover and RPO/RTO acceptance belong to separate U06 work.

binary.installation: New no-replace protected path; copied to a new inode, digest checked, atomically linked, staging name retired and directory synchronized. No old executable overwritten.

cli.batch_binding: First directory below both roots exactly equals the purpose batch segment
cli.expected_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; plaintext SHA-256 from the original seal report

opening_guards: Canonical absolute paths, component-bound fixed roots, no symlink component, no dot or empty path segment
Owned 0700 directories at and below the evidence roots; output root and parent independently checked as actual tmpfs
Configuration, key and ciphertext opened with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK; regular, exact 0600, owner, single-link and inode checks; reads use held descriptors
Exactly 32 raw key bytes, no aliases between configured input/key/output paths
Plaintext stays in a private temporary tmpfs directory until complete footer authentication, digest, byte count, frame count and no-trailing-data checks succeed
Expected plaintext SHA is compared before output publication
Atomic no-replace output publication, successful staging-link retirement, parent synchronization, final 0600 single-link inode check
Failure removes private staging and only this invocation's same-inode uncommitted publication; existing outputs are preserved
Only static redacted errors and aggregate successful digests/lengths are emitted

build.cache_initialization: Registry copied from an existing read-only cache into the separate U06 cache

ignored_existing_requirements: UUID_IMPORT_SQL_DIR in a private tmpfs parent
isolated PG17 fixture with actual three-service migrations
new_coverage: Real old-seal/new-open multiframe roundtrip and no overwrite
Final-footer truncation and corruption, wrong key, wrong purpose, wrong plaintext digest and trailing bytes never publish output or retain staging
Input/key/config symlinks, hardlinks and public permissions are rejected
Fixed roots, batch binding, U06 purpose/profile, private parent and canonical path policy
Existing output symlink inode and target bytes remain unchanged; actual ordinary-disk output roots are rejected
rust_tests.fixture_isolation: Unit fixtures use unique private roots; they do not create or chmod real U06 evidence roots

protected_binary_cli_tests.execution: Fresh isolated Linux Docker container, network none, protected executable and workspace read-only, private 128 MiB shared memory
protected_binary_cli_tests.result: Actual installed release binary seals and opens multiframe data; every authentication negative fails with no output/staging; existing files and output symlinks are preserved

independent_review.reviewed: Held descriptors, purpose/batch binding, tmpfs confinement, full authentication before publication, no-replace publication and inode-aware failure cleanup
closed_findings: Unit tests no longer touch production roots
